summary: GRI 306: Effluents and Waste 2016 addresses water discharges, the generation, treatment and disposal of waste, and spills of chemicals, oils, fuels and other substances. It was superseded by GRI 306: Waste 2020 and GRI 303: Water and Effluents 2018 (only Disclosure 306-3 remains in effect).

disclosures.title: Water discharge by quality and destination

questions.text: What is the total volume of planned and unplanned water discharges?
questions.hint: Break down by: i. destination; ii. quality of the water, including treatment method; iii. whether the water was reused by another organization.

questions.text: Which standards, methodologies and assumptions were used?

disclosures.title: Waste by type and disposal method

questions.text: What is the total weight of hazardous waste, by disposal method?
questions.hint: Break down by disposal method where applicable: i. reuse; ii. recycling; iii. composting; iv. recovery, including energy recovery; v. incineration (mass burn); vi. deep well injection; vii. landfill; viii. on-site storage; ix. other (specify).

questions.text: What is the total weight of non-hazardous waste, by disposal method?
questions.hint: Break down by disposal method where applicable: i. reuse; ii. recycling; iii. composting; iv. recovery, including energy recovery; v. incineration (mass burn); vi. deep well injection; vii. landfill; viii. on-site storage; ix. other (specify).

questions.text: How was the waste disposal method determined?
questions.hint: i. Disposed of directly by the organization, or otherwise directly confirmed; ii. information provided by the waste disposal contractor; iii. organizational defaults of the waste disposal contractor.

questions.text: What is the total number and total volume of recorded significant spills?
questions.hint: Total number and total volume of recorded significant spills.

questions.text: For each spill reported in the financial statements, what were the location, volume and material of the spill?
questions.hint: i. Location; ii. volume; iii. material, categorized as oil spills, fuel spills, spills of wastes, spills of chemicals, or other (specify).

questions.text: What were the impacts of significant spills?
What is the total weight of hazardous waste transported, imported, exported and treated?
questions.hint: Total weight for each: i. hazardous waste transported; ii. imported; iii. exported; iv. treated.

questions.text: What percentage of hazardous waste is shipped internationally?
questions.hint: Percentage of hazardous waste shipped internationally.

questions.text: Which standards, methodologies and assumptions were used?

disclosures.title: Water bodies affected by water discharges and/or runoff

questions.text: Which water bodies and related habitats are significantly affected by water discharges and/or runoff?
questions.hint: Include: i. size of the water body and habitat; ii. whether it is designated as a nationally or internationally protected area; iii. biodiversity value, such as total number of protected species.
